entities.name: Measurement Reporting Procedure
entities.description: Procedure to transfer measurement results from the UE to the network. The UE initiates this procedure only after successful AS security activation.

entities.name: MeasurementReport Message
entities.description: RRC message used to transfer measurement results from UE to network.

entities.name: measResults
entities.description: Main container for measurement results in MeasurementReport message.

entities.name: measResultServingCell
entities.description: Contains RSRP, RSRQ and available SINR measurements for serving cells.

entities.name: measResultNeighCells
entities.description: Contains measurement results for neighboring cells.

entities.name: measResultBestNeighCell
entities.description: Contains measurement results for the best non-serving cell.

entities.name: AS security activation
entities.description: Condition that UE shall initiate measurement reporting only after successful AS security activation.

entities.name: periodical reporting timer
entities.description: Timer used for periodical measurement reporting.

entities.name: Increment numberOfReportsSent
entities.description: UE increments the numberOfReportsSent counter by 1 for each measurement report.

entities.name: measId
entities.description: Measurement identity that triggered the measurement reporting.

relations.description: Measurement reporting procedure involves sending MeasurementReport message.
measResults contains measResultServingCell for serving cell measurements.
measResults contains measResultNeighCells for neighboring cell measurements.
measResults contains measResultBestNeighCell for best non-serving cell measurements.
Measurement reporting procedure requires AS security to be activated.
Procedure stops the periodical reporting timer when triggered.
Procedure starts the periodical reporting timer if numberOfReportsSent is less than reportAmount.
MeasurementReport message includes the measId that triggered the reporting.
